description: Start here for a general privacy question. One keyword search across the whole hub: short checked answers to common questions (each with its sources, the guide it comes from and the date that guide was checked), directory tools, how-to guides, curated tool stacks and the glossary. Use 1–3 keywords such as 'vpn', 'data broker' or 'grapheneos'; every keyword must match, and filler words like 'how', 'best' and 'private' are ignored. Returns the top few results of each type, each with type, title, slug, a one-line summary and its Default Privacy url. The type-specific tools are for the rest: dp_search_tools for filters (open source, e2ee, category…), dp_get_tool / dp_get_guide / dp_get_stack / dp_get_glossary_term for full content, and dp_find_alternatives to replace a named product such as WhatsApp or Gmail.
name: dp_search
title: Search everything
